content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

This infrastructure is designed to operate independently of the financial restrictions imposed by conventional payment platforms. Many creators in countries such as Nigeria and Venezuela face barriers that prevent them from accessing services like Stripe and PayPal. By leveraging open-source tools and decentralized payment systems, you gain full control over your sales and data. This is not a workaround; it’s a foundational shift that empowers you to conduct business on your terms, ensuring you keep the profits without paying hefty fees to restrictive platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To start selling digital products, you need a few essential components. First, choose a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for a cost-effective website presence. Next, set up a backend logic system using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage your product delivery and order processing. You will also need a storage solution, either Supabase or Google Sheets, for order management, and a file delivery system such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions seamlessly, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without any KYC requirements.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments in USD. This will allow you to automatically convert and process transactions at the time of sale. Next, set up your digital products for automated delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This ensures that once the payment is confirmed, your customers receive their products instantly and securely. By automating these processes, you can focus on creating content rather than managing transactions.
Keep 99.5% of your profits with low transaction fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Ensure your website is fully functional, and conduct a test run of the entire process from payment to product delivery. This is crucial for identifying any potential issues before you start promoting your products. Once you’re confident everything works seamlessly, launch your store. Start processing your first transactions, and monitor them closely to ensure you’re able to handle customer inquiries and feedback effectively.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial sales, focus on scaling your operations. Analyze customer feedback and sales data to refine your offerings. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates, which can streamline your processes further. As your sales volume grows, consider expanding your product range or exploring new marketing strategies to reach more customers. This infrastructure allows you to scale without facing the limitations imposed by traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign digital commerce stack. This involves utilizing hosting platforms like GitHub Pages for your store, integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions, and automating delivery with backend scripts. With this setup, you keep more of your profits without paying high platform fees.
Automate delivery for instant customer satisfaction.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you want to delve deeper into building your own digital store without the constraints of traditional platforms, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It equips you with everything you need to deploy and scale your sovereign digital commerce infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify your digital products and prepare them for sale. Choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Configure NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency payments. Automate product delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Conduct a test transaction to ensure the process works. Launch your online store and start promoting your products.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up my own digital download store?

To set up your digital download store, select a hosting solution and configure your backend logic for processing orders. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions and automate delivery. This will ensure customers receive their products instantly upon payment confirmation.
What are the fees associated with selling digital products?

Using NOWPayments incurs a 0.5% fee per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad that charge 10%. This means more profit for you with every sale, especially as your volume increases.
Can I use this infrastructure for selling different types of digital products?

Yes, this infrastructure is versatile and effective for a range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and software. Customize it to fit your specific needs and product types.
Is there a limit to the number of products I can sell?
There is no strict limit to the number of products you can sell. As your infrastructure is set up to scale, you can continue adding products to your store without facing any barriers.
How do I handle customer support after launching my store?

Implement a simple customer support system, such as email or a contact form on your website. Ensure you can respond quickly to inquiries about payments or product delivery to maintain customer satisfaction.
Retain complete ownership and control of your digital products.
